messages:
marie: opened PR 8347 to add a small Console observability example that shows trace propagation + cost/latency tags. adding Python + Rust snippets and a YAML migration note (snake_case rename). also fixed a stale dashboard anchor. reviewers?

hugo: pinged. where are the changes? I can check the anchors and verify the example image path.

marie: docs/console/instrumentation and docs/dashboards/row-mapping. change summary: rename `costMetrics` -> `cost_metrics` and `latencyBuckets` -> `latency_buckets` in the YAML example; show both keys for backwards compatibility. snippets: Python and Rust to cover examples runner.

sasha: please paste the snippets so I can run and smoke-test in the runner.

marie: Python snippet:
```py
# Python (redwood==0.11)
import os
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))

# attach trace metadata and cost/latency tags
c.attach_trace(trace_id='tr-42', attrs={'route':'/v1/generate','model':'r-2'}, cost={'tokens':25}, latency_buckets=[50,200,500])
# subsequent c.generate(..., trace_context=c.current_trace())
```

marie: Rust snippet:
```rust
// Rust (redwood-sdk 0.2+)
use redwood::Client;
let client = Client::new(std::env::var("REDWOOD_KEY").unwrap());
client.attach_trace("tr-42", Some(map!["route"=>"/v1/generate","model"=>"r-2"]), Some(redwood::Cost{tokens:25}), Some(vec![50,200,500]));
// pass trace handle into client.generate(...)
```

hugo: nit: Rust example uses a map! macro that's not in std; maybe show literal HashMap construction to avoid confusion. also add SDK version callouts: Python 0.11+, Rust 0.2+.

marie: good point. I'll replace map! with a short HashMap example and add version notes above snippets.

docs-bot: link-checker: replaced /docs/dashboards#old-row-anchor -> /docs/dashboards#row-mapping. please confirm the anchor exists and update any permalinks.

sasha: ran examples: Python works after adding `os` import; Rust compiles after switching to HashMap construction and importing std::collections::HashMap. updated snippet locally and added the change to the PR.

ben: migration note suggestion: show a tiny YAML compatibility block like:
```yaml
# new
cost_metrics: { tokens: 0 }
latency_buckets: [50,200]
# legacy (still accepted)
costMetrics: { tokens: 0 }  # deprecated
latencyBuckets: [50,200]  # deprecated
```

marie: adding that. also adding a short FAQ entry: "Will old embedded dashboards break?" -> "No, server accepts legacy keys but will log deprecation warnings; update embeds to snake_case for future-proofing."

hugo: add an alt-text note for the dashboard screenshot. accessibility team flagged one of our earlier examples.

marie: will do. adding descriptive alt text and uploading the image to assets.

docs-bot: ci: suggested job docs-ci/yaml-parse added to PR checks (parses examples/trace_sample.yaml). recommend non-blocking for first rollout.

sasha: ran yaml-parse locally 10/10. will ask infra to flip the CI job to required after one release.

ben: one more: the Python snippet used attach_trace camelCase in a prior version; note that SDK 0.11+ exposes attach_trace and older 0.9 used attachTrace. tiny compatibility note would avoid confusion.

marie: adding: "SDK note: v0.11+ uses attach_trace; older clients may use attachTrace shim."

hugo: LGTM once the small snippet and YAML tweaks land. please squash commits.

marie: squashing and pushing fixes now. PR description will include `docs: trace-prop-examples` so release tooling picks it up. merging after CI green.

sasha: verified after fixes 1: both snippets render in runner and YAML parse job is green locally.

docs-bot: ci: docs-ci/yaml-parse succeeded on branch.

marie: merging. will open a short changelog entry under "migration: yaml-key-names" and follow up with a short internal note for platform teams. thanks!
